hero.caption:
Signboard of the Makam Diraja Langgar located in the state of Kelantan in Malaysia. The signboard uses the Jawi script written in simple Islamic calligraphy.  The Jawi text reads: مقام دراج لڠڬر 
The Jawi script does not use diacritics. Diacritics are used when writing Jawi in Islamic calligraphy style.
